moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tr-push, written here): Incoming scene x +100 % -> 0 while the outgoing x 0 -> -100 % (one frame width), together, 400 ms easeInOutCubic (recipe range 300-500 ms), from the right; no gap, no scale, no fade.
